name: print-social-indigo-carousel-slide-with-yellow-phone-frame-and-round-avatar
title: Organizer Profiles Slide with Yellow Phone Frame
whatItIs: An indigo carousel slide with a large white headline 'Organizer Profiles: Search your favourites by their @.', a phone inside a rounded yellow frame showing a search screen with a floating search card, and a round photo of a smiling woman with a green ring overlapping the phone.
whatItMeans: Yellow on indigo is a strong pairing, and the overlapping avatar bubble puts a person next to the feature.
techniques: Phone set inside a rounded coloured frame
Floating search card lifted out of the screen
Round photo with a coloured ring overlapping the device
Site name anchored at the bottom left

vocabulary.definition: A coloured shape framing a phone mockup.
An interface element lifted off the screen.
A round photo with a ring placed over the layout.
